runs.name: Horiba, Ltd.
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **¥26,330** (TSE 6856, close 2026-10-09, the last full session, 2026-10-12 a Japanese holiday; Yahoo Finance chart feed, aggregator, flagged); the HRIBF OTC print $137.00, unmoved since at least 2026-10-05, flagged stale and not used; HRBAY is an unsponsored ADS (F-6EF filings by The Bank of New York Mellon 2025-09-29, accession 0001019155-25-000400, and Citibank 2025-11-19, accession 0001193805-25-001622), its ratio not used. Shares **42,021,555** (42,233,252 issued less 211,697 treasury, H1 2026 summary of 2026-08-07; one class; 299,500 treasury shares cancelled 2024-06-05; no split in ten years); cap **¥1,106.4bn**. Sovereign **4.134%** (Japan MoF jgbcme.csv 30-year, 2026-10-08). Not an SEC registrant (`run.py` 404, `cover_shares.py` no periodic filing): every figure by hand from the yuho FY2016 to FY2025 (latest filed 2026-03-23), the semi-annual report filed 2026-08-10 and the company's English releases, documents recorded by date; one figure cross-checked (FY2025 operating cash ¥54,383m and sales ¥333,081m, identical in the yuho and the English release of 2026-02-12). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the yuho's business description, Business Risks and management's analysis, as the overnight brief directs. Segments: five (Automotive, Process & Environmental, Medical-Diagnostics, Semiconductor, Scientific) became three from 2025-01-01 (Energy & Environment, Bio & Healthcare, Materials & Semiconductor); acquisitions Process Instruments (2023-10) and EtaMax (2025-04). **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: the deciding part, mass flow controllers and process monitors for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, earned 87% of operating profit FY2020-24 and 84% in FY2025 (inside Materials & Semiconductor); its ten-year economics turn on keeping its position through each generation of process technology, a risk the company's own yuho (Business Risks (1)) rates likely and large; contrary evidence written down: the company's own estimate of its MFC share rose from 47% (2011) to 60% (fiscal 2024) and the segment margin from 22.7%-29.5% (FY2015-20) to 32.2%-36.8% (FY2021-24); segment profit ¥9.4bn (2015) to ¥44.2bn (2024). NATURE, no research pass. Q2 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, recorded not weighed: no rival named in the yuho or the integrated report, so no comparison (a gap, not filled from memory); Automotive lost money in FY2021-22 and Bio & Healthcare in FY2024-25; equity ¥127bn to ¥349bn FY2015-25, goodwill negligible, net cash about ¥6bn to about ¥98bn (¥102.6bn at 2026-06-30, ¥96.3bn after the interim dividend); inventories 34% of sales in 2023 (23%-26% before), partly reversed; capital spending above depreciation in nine of ten years; one buyback (2024) at an average ¥14,942; integrity facts recorded, not judged: a ¥240 commemorative dividend declared to mark the market capitalization passing ¥1 trillion; the Chairman's bonus pool tied to ROE with no capital charge, his pay ¥458m. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after all capital spending, finance-lease principal and stock pay averaged **¥18.5bn** FY2021-25 (¥17.5bn after acquisitions) against average net income ¥33.3bn; **range ¥15,010 to ¥35,052 a share** all-equity at 4.134% against ¥26,330; floor tested first, no case earns it at the price (¥7,549 and ¥13,133 at ten percent); fair price beneath the stop **¥10,341 all-equity**, ¥8,640 equity-only; not armed (box not OUT at Q7). Contamination declared by the analyst: session-context git status (AYI, ARCB research folders), commit subjects about GRFXY and the memory index's general queue lines; nothing on Horiba; none used. Commits e2025aa5, b4d718a2, f5662dfd. Citations: the analyst's check PASS; the dispatcher's adjacency script 32 distinct ids resolved, 0 E-ids, 18 adjacent fragments, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) when Q7 specific (e) puts the maintenance case central, the text does not say whether growth is measured on the maintenance-only or the all-spending aggregate series (12.1% against 1.2% here; the top of the range moves from about ¥13,100 to ¥35,100); (2) the all-equity basis does not say whether interest earned on net cash is removed (the analyst removed it after tax); (3) the brief has no rule for when the annual report names no rival; (4) Q1 has no test separating a product function stable for decades from an industry whose technology moves fast, so another analyst could reach Q2 on this name; (5) an interim dividend paid after the balance-sheet date was deducted as a subsequent event; (6) the template and `run.py` assume an SEC filer.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): a Kyoto maker of measuring and analysis instruments whose deciding part, semiconductor mass flow controllers and process monitors (84% to 88% of operating profit), must hold its place through each generation of chip process technology, a risk its own yuho rates likely and large; its own estimated MFC share rose from 47% (2011) to 60% (2024) and the segment margin to 32%-37%, written down as contrary evidence. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash ¥18.5bn a year FY2021-25 against net income ¥33.3bn; range ¥15,010 to ¥35,052 a share against ¥26,330, no case earns the floor at the price; fair ¥10,341 all-equity (¥8,640 equity-only), not armed. After the stop: net cash about ¥98bn, no rival named in the report; integrity facts recorded, not judged: a commemorative dividend for a ¥1 trillion market value.
